method: Page fetched directly with curl and converted from HTML to text. Every claim is verbatim-checked against that file with scripts/verify.py. Prose paraphrases; source_text stays verbatim. Modification date read from the page metadata (2026-06-30). This page was available when docs/source-landscape.md recorded ASHM as exhausted; that entry was wrong and is corrected in the same commit.

claims.claim: Scabies and pubic lice are the commonest genital ectoparasites
claims.source_text: The most common genital and pubic ectoparasite infestations are scabies and pubic lice (Pediculosis pubis or crabs)

claims.claim: Scabies associated with crowding and institutional outbreaks
claims.source_text: Scabies is associated with crowded living and sleeping conditions and institutional outbreaks have been reported

claims.claim: Pubic lice typical in sexually active young people
claims.source_text: Pubic lice is found typically in sexually active young people

claims.claim: Causative organisms
claims.source_text: Pubic lice is caused by Pthirus pubis. … Scabies is caused by Sarcoptes scabiei var hominis

claims.claim: Scabies transmission and fomites
claims.source_text: Close, prolonged (15-20 min) skin contact, person-to-person transmission. … Fomite transmission possible. … May survive > 3 days off host in tropics but < 36hours usually

claims.claim: Pubic lice transmission and survival
claims.source_text: Transmitted by close body contact. … Survive less than 24 hours off host. … Fomite transmission plays little role. … Not a vector for other diseases

claims.claim: Clinical signs are an allergic response to mite bites
claims.source_text: Clinical signs are due to allergy to bites by the mite

claims.claim: Presenting symptoms
claims.source_text: Pubic or genital itch (especially at night with scabies) and/or rash … Scabies: genital (penile, scrotal, vulval) papulonodule … Crabs: debris in underwear

claims.claim: Complications of scabies and pubic lice
claims.source_text: Scabies: complications uncommon and mostly in crusted scabies … Fever (children) … Pain on movement … Sleep disturbance … Secondary infection … Pubic lice: fever, lethargy, irritability (more common in the young and frail)

claims.claim: Pubic lice diagnosis by visualisation
claims.source_text: Direct visualisation +/- magnification of crab or eggs (nits) … Adult lice infest strong hairs (pubic hair, trunk, chest and buttock; rarely eyebrows and eyelashes) … Eggs (nits) are strongly attached to the hairs

claims.claim: Scabies is a clinical diagnosis aided by dermatoscope
claims.source_text: Usually a clinical diagnosis. … A dermatoscope/magnifying glass can aid diagnosis

claims.claim: Definitive scabies methods are impractical in general practice
claims.source_text: Multiple methods requiring moderate degree of skill and equipment. Not usually practical in general practice … not generally available in general practice, seek specialist advice

claims.claim: Characteristic scabies signs and burrow sites
claims.source_text: Characteristic nodule and silvery skin burrows sometimes seen e.g. nodule on glans penis and scrotum concurrently, labial fold nodule, burrows (inter-digital folds, wrists and elbows, around breast nipples in women)

claims.claim: Skin scraping technique
claims.source_text: Scabies: skin scraping taken from burrows with a fine needle to reveal the mite after examination under light microscopy

claims.claim: Permethrin 5% regimen for scabies
claims.source_text: Apply permethrin cream 5% topically to dry skin from the neck down, especially hands and genitalia, and under the nails with a nailbrush. Leave on the skin for a minimum of 8 hours (usually overnight) and reapply to hands if they are washed. … The time may be increased to 24 hours if there has been a treatment failure. Repeat treatment in 1 week to improve success rate

claims.claim: Benzyl benzoate 25% alternative
claims.source_text: Apply benzyl benzoate 25% emulsion topically to dry skin from the neck down, paying particular attention to hands and genitalia, and under the nails with a nailbrush. Leave on for 24 hours and reapply to hands if they are washed. … Repeat treatment in 7 days

claims.claim: Pyrethrin with piperonyl butoxide for pubic lice
claims.source_text: Apply pyrethrin 0.165% + piperonyl butoxide 1.65% topical foam to pubic and other hair infested with lice and wash off after 10 minutes. … Repeat treatment in 1 week

claims.claim: Shaving and egg removal not required
claims.source_text: Shaving pubic hair and removal of eggs is not required

claims.claim: No demonstrated permethrin resistance in pubic lice
claims.source_text: Compared with head lice, resistance to permethrin treatment of pubic lice has not been demonstrated

claims.claim: Crusted scabies definition and populations
claims.source_text: Crusted scabies (formerly called Norwegian scabies) occurs when the mite population is very high due to poor host immune response, such as in people with HIV infection, and also in people living in remote Aboriginal and Torres Strait Island communities. Seek specialist advice for treatment

claims.claim: Ivermectin for less severe crusted scabies
claims.source_text: Ivermectin 200mcg/kg PO on days 1, and second dose between day 8-14. … An additional dose maybe required for moderate -severe scabies but seek specialist advice

claims.claim: Pre-treat severe impetigo before antiscabetic treatment
claims.source_text: If secondary bacterial infection (impetigo) is severe, pre-treat with antibiotics to cover S. aureus and/or S. pyogenes before administering antiscabetic treatment

claims.claim: Ivermectin for persistent infection after topical failure
claims.source_text: Ivermectin 200 mcg/kg PO on days 1 and 8-14, not before 4 weeks after failure of both topical permethrin and benzyl benzoate

claims.claim: Scabies treatment advice
claims.source_text: Avoid close body contact. … Patient and recent partner/s should complete treatment. … Apply cream at night, including finger webs and do not wash hands after applying cream. … Isolate clothes, towels and bed linen from previous 3 days and launder as usual the day after first treatment. Or simply isolate these items for > 1 week while mites die

claims.claim: Cap of two applications and two-week symptom persistence
claims.source_text: Avoid more than 2 applications of treatment to prevent persistent irritation. … Symptoms and signs may not clear for 2 weeks. … Antipruritic treatments (antihistamine oral medication; calamine lotion and topical steroid creams e.g. hydrocortisone 1%) can be helpful

claims.claim: Pubic lice laundering advice
claims.source_text: Isolate clothes, towels and bed linen from previous 3 days and launder as usual the day after first treatment

claims.claim: No sexual contact for 7 days and contact tracing
claims.source_text: Advise no sexual contact for 7 days after treatment is commenced, or until the course is completed and symptoms resolved, whichever is later. … Contact tracing

claims.claim: Contact tracing scope for scabies and pubic lice
claims.source_text: Scabies: simultaneous treatment of sexual contacts and all household members of the past month. … Pubic lice: simultaneous treatment of recent sexual contacts and all household members

claims.claim: Permethrin safe in pregnancy and breastfeeding
claims.source_text: Permethrin is safe in pregnancy and during breast feeding

claims.claim: Whole community treatment may be required in remote settings
claims.source_text: No special differences. Scabies may affect entire small remote communities where a whole community treatment regimen may be required. Seek local advice

claims.claim: Eyelash infestation treatment
claims.source_text: Ophthalmic-grade petrolatum ointment bd for 10 days (prescription needed and compounding pharmacist to make)

claims.claim: One week review purpose
claims.source_text: Confirm patient adherence with treatment and assess for symptom resolution … Confirm contact tracing procedures have been undertaken or offer more contact tracing support … Educate about condom use, contraception, HIV PrEP/PEP, safe injecting practices, consent, CST and vaccinations for HAV, HBV and HPV as indicated

claims.claim: Seek specialist advice for complicated or persisting presentations
claims.source_text: Consider seeking specialist advice before treating any complicated or persisting presentation
